page.overview:
What is Fish Market?

Fish Market is a square in Novigrad located in the city center just southwest of Hierarch Square. It's a place where various goods, mainly all kinds of fish, are brought to and traded. In northeast corner a blacksmith has his shop and there is also a merchant selling mainly crafting components, alchemical ingredients and some food and drink items.

Peace is ensured by the Temple Guard under commander Gilbert Witschke.

Merchant and Blacksmith will appear from 5 am - 7 am, taking an hour break, before appearing again from 8am - 7pm
